output.headline: PermitPilot takes the belt in sudden death
whyTheyWon: Won problem, willingness to pay, moat, go-to-market, and scale.
Lost market, differentiation, timing, and feasibility by wider margins.
Less than half a point separated the damage totals; the closings broke it.

turningPoint.text: The expediter channel closed the gap in the final round.

loserTakeaways: Win one more criterion in the final round.
Bring a sourced number for the backlog.

announcerLines.text: Sudden death. PermitPilot takes the belt, three votes to one.
